scope: ten unresolved HEMS facilities supplied by the parent task

source_method_notes.official: HEMS Ministry of Health establishment directory and the normalized HEMS record cache
source_method_notes.google: Google Maps place/search discovery was usable; Google Search returned an unusual-traffic interstitial in the browser
source_method_notes.nominatim: Nominatim API name searches returned no exact facility records; the public OSM search UI was used for resort/island context
source_method_notes.overpass: Overpass queries were attempted against public mirrors but returned 504/timeouts; no Overpass-only candidate was accepted
source_method_notes.osm_api: Live OSM API fetches returned HTTP 200 for every listed OSM object
